what: A step with actor human writes one waiting_item (needs, why, choices, recommended) into Waiting on you and the engine resumes when it is answered; add `switchboard waiting list --json`, oldest first.
expectations: Each human step raises exactly one open item; re-running the step does not raise a second.
The item shows the step's needs and why lines and its choices, with the recommended one first.
An answered item moves the unit to the state the answer maps to.
`switchboard waiting list --json` lists open items oldest first.
